hints.title: Three-Valued Logic
hints.text: In SQL, comparing against NULL using the equality operator always evaluates to unknown. Use the IS NULL predicate.

hints.title: Field Selection
hints.text: Filter records from the books table where the rating column is NULL, selecting book_id, title, author, and published_year.

hints.title: Sorting
hints.text: Order the resulting records by book_id in ascending order.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    book_id, 
    title, 
    author, 
    published_year
FROM 
    books
WHERE 
    rating IS NULL
ORDER BY 
    book_id ASC;
```

variables: n: number of rows in books table
complexity.notes: Table scan filtering unrated records with sort on primary key.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Using '= NULL' fails in SQL three-valued logic; IS NULL predicate is required.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) space for sorting the filtered result.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies proper NULL check syntax and sorts output by book_id ascending.
